# A2.10 Clarifying question and checkpoint builder

## Owner
A2

## Stage
Understand

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
CP-07

## Input (reads)
Any TBD found by A2 skills

## Steps
1. List each TBD with the file and line it appears in.
2. Write the question with 2-3 options.
3. Send each to A1.05 as a checkpoint

## Output (writes)
Checkpoint requests (CP-07 entries)

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/checkpoints/CP-07-<topic>.md`

## Verification
Every TBD in the stories folder has one checkpoint entry

## Checkpoints raised
- none
